lines.text: The king rejoices in the LORD's strength, and the LORD has not withheld the request of his lips.
The LORD welcomes the king with rich blessings and places a crown of bronze on his head.
The king asked for life, and the LORD granted length of days forever and ever, cheering him with joy in His presence.
The king trusts in the LORD and will not be shaken, while the LORD's hand will seize His enemies and place them in a fiery furnace.
The enemies' schemes will prevail, but the LORD puts them to flight with His bow, and the people sing His praise.

wrong_details.true: the schemes they devise will not prevail
